mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logistics_fulfillment_commands (command_id,operation,order_id,order_number,carrier,tracking_number,expected_version,package_id) VALUES (#{commandId},#{operation},#{orderId},#{orderNumber},#{carrier},#{trackingNumber},#{expectedVersion}, #{packageId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,platform_shipment_no,shipment_version FROM logistics_fulfillment_commands WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND shipment_version IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE logistics_fulfillment_commands SET owner_token=#{owner}, lease_until=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '30' SECOND WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND shipment_version IS NULL AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

UPDATE logistics_fulfillment_commands SET platform_shipment_no=#{receipt.platformShipmentNo},shipment_version=#{receipt.shipmentVersion}, owner_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE command_id=#{receipt.commandId} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE logistics_fulfillment_commands SET owner_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND owner_token=#{owner}
